gloss: person who has remarried; remarried person

definitions.gloss: person who has remarried; remarried person
definitions.explanation: someone who has married again after a previous marriage ended in divorce or the death of a spouse

examples.japanese: {再婚者|さいこんしゃ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{割合|わりあい}→割合：01760_wariai⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{増|ふ}えている→増える：01183_fueru⟧。
examples.english: The proportion of remarried people is increasing.

examples.japanese: {再婚者|さいこんしゃ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{子連|こづ}れ⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{場合|ばあい}→場合：01704_baai⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧。
examples.english: Some remarried people bring children from a previous marriage.

examples.japanese: ⟦{結婚式場|けっこんしきじょう}→結婚式場：30785_kekkonshikijou⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{再婚者|さいこんしゃ}{向|む}け⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦プラン→プラン：00345_puran⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧⟦{用意|ようい}→用意：01746_youi⟧⟦されている→する：00392_suru⟧。

notes:
A compound of ⟦{再婚|さいこん}→再婚：22805_saikon⟧ (remarriage) and ⟦{者|しゃ}→〜者：04662_sha⟧ (person). Used in demographics, legal contexts, and discussions about family structures.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {再婚者|さいこんしゃ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{割合|わりあい}→割合：01760_wariai⟧: proportion of remarried people
- {再婚者|さいこんしゃ}⟦{同士|どうし}→同士：03474_doushi⟧: two remarried people (marrying each other)
- {子連|こづ}れ{再婚者|さいこんしゃ}: remarried person with children

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {初婚者|しょこんしゃ}: person marrying for the first time
- ⟦バツイチ→バツイチ：11119_batsuichi⟧: divorced person (colloquial) — literally "one strike," from the × mark used to cross out a marriage record

REGISTER:
Formal. Used in statistics, legal documents, and news articles. In casual conversation, people are more likely to say ⟦{再婚|さいこん}した→再婚する：25476_saikonsuru⟧⟦{人|ひと}→人：00476_hito⟧ (a person who remarried).
